import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem finite_simultaneous_comparison_closed {ι X Y : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
  [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [LinearOrder Y] [OrderTopology Y]
  (f g : ι → X → Y) (hf : ∀ i, Continuous (f i)) (hg : ∀ i, Continuous (g i)) :
  IsClosed {x | ∀ i, f i x ≤ g i x} := by
  have : {x | ∀ i, f i x ≤ g i x} = ⋂ i, {x | f i x ≤ g i x} := by
    ext x
    simp
  rw [this]
  exact isClosed_iInter fun i => isClosed_le (hf i) (hg i)

  rw [this]

theorem finite_simultaneous_comparison_closed {ι X Y : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
  [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [LinearOrder Y] [OrderTopology Y]

import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem finite_simultaneous_comparison_closed {ι X Y : Type*} [Fintype ι] [Nonempty ι]
  [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [LinearOrder Y] [OrderTopology Y]
  (f g : ι → X → Y) (hf : ∀ i, Continuous (f i)) (hg : ∀ i, Continuous (g i)) :
  IsClosed {x | ∀ i, f i x ≤ g i x} := by
  have h_closed : ∀ i, IsClosed {x | f i x ≤ g i x} := by
    intro i
    have h_cont : Continuous (fun x => (f i x, g i x)) :=
      Continuous.prodMk (hf i) (hg i)
    have h_closed_set : IsClosed {p : Y × Y | p.1 ≤ p.2} :=
      isClosed_le continuous_fst continuous_snd
    exact h_closed_set.preimage h_cont
  rw [setOf_forall]
  exact isClosed_iInter h_closed
